editorial_review.scope: All 55 French verses aligned and second pass reread by native Hebrew lemma and French occurrence, including the versification shift at 31:55.
notes: Gen 31:1–18: grouped time idioms and elliptical possession; preserved Bethel IDs.
Gen 31:19–42: grouped stealing the heart, setting the face, repeated verb forms, idiomatic expressions, and omitted grammatical material.
Gen 31:43–54: reviewed nominal copulas, covenant formula, witness names and relational phrases; supplied subjects kept contextual.
LSG Gen 31:55 is native Hebrew Gen 32:1. Both source XML blobs are locked and native IDs preserved. LSG Gen 32:1–32 will therefore map to Hebrew Gen 32:2–33.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes by same editor; no independent audit or dictionary-sense verification. Publication checks deferred.
